exact_statement: Fix a nonconstant d-bit full-affine-span affine-influence-minimal Boolean seed g, entropy H0, influence I0, a fixed integer r>=0, K>=0, k>=2, p=2^-k and t=2^k. Activate the product of t disjoint seed copies on k zero controls. For every adaptive tree of at most r original DATA-coordinate queries, with controls unresolved and no intervening input resets, every complete leaf F_b, affinely optimized only after querying, satisfies |H(F_b)-H0|<=p[r(d+H0)+10k+15] and |a(F_b)-I0|<=p[r(d+I0)+2k]. Thus its optimized deficit differs from H0-KI0 by at most E=p[r(d+H0)+10k+15+K(r(d+I0)+2k)]. If Delta=H0-KI0>E, every complete leaf violates K and the expected terminal reserve E_b[K a(F_b)-H(F_b)]<=-Delta+E<0. Expected total queried influence is at most rp and expected terminal reset release at most prd. This statement concerns bounded original-data query trees, not control queries or policies changing input bases between queries.
